doc.summary: Secure polyglot directory traversal and file analysis.
doc.description:
The scanner walks a directory tree, applies security and size checks,
resolves each supported file through ParserFactory, and returns a
flat list of Node and Edge objects that form the knowledge graph.

doc.summary: Recursive directory scanner with security and size guards.
doc.description:
Rejects symlinks, enforces file-size and directory-depth limits,
skips ignored directories, and silently catches parse errors
so a single misbehaving file never breaks the full scan.

Supports privacy mode (strips snippets and docstrings) and
gitignore-aware scanning for more accurate project coverage.

doc.summary: Initialise the scanner with application configuration.

params.name: config
params.description: Settings including ignore dirs, size limits, etc.

doc.summary: Return ``True`` for artifacts readmenator itself wrote into the project.
doc.description:
Rescanning its own output (agent docs, wiki, rules, maps, refactor
scripts) would feed generated noise back into the graph and skew
indexes, centrality, and purposes on every rebuild.

params.name: rel_path
params.description: Path relative to the scan root.

returns.description: Whether the path belongs to a readmenator-generated artifact.

name: scan
signature: def scan(self, root: Path) -> Tuple[List[Node], List[Edge]]

doc.summary: Walk *root* recursively and produce (nodes, edges) for the graph.
doc.description:
Security checks (symlinks, size, depth, ignore dirs) are applied
per file. Parse failures are silently caught so a single broken
file never blocks the rest of the scan.

returns.description:
A tuple of (list of Node, list of Edge). Edges represent
``imports`` relationships between scanned files.

name: scan_with_content
signature: def scan_with_content(self, root: Path) -> Tuple[List[Node], List[Edge], Dict[str, str]]

doc.summary: Scan and also return raw file contents for deeper analysis.

returns.description:
Tuple of (nodes, edges, content_map) where content_map maps
node_id to raw file content.

name: scan_contents
signature: def scan_contents(self, contents: Dict[str, str]) -> Tuple[List[Node], List[Edge], Dict[str, str]]

doc.summary: Scan an in-memory file map instead of the filesystem.
doc.description:
Used to replay historical trees read from git: the same parsers,
the same file-level doc extraction, the same generated-output
filtering, but over contents that already live in memory.

params.name: contents
params.description: Mapping of relative file path to raw file content.

returns.description: Tuple of (list of Node, list of Edge, content map).
